manifest.primary: All completed valid A/U decode-throughput ratios, including short EOS; preserve all raw pairs and invalid-ratio records
manifest.secondary: Both arms reach the same predeclared cap: English64 or repeat67; report eligible N
manifest.stopping: No outcome-based stop. Stop for structural/protocol/identity fault, numerical engine failure, interruption or predeclared timeout/budget only.
manifest.independence: 100 request pairs clustered in 20 paired engine blocks; identical input schedule is not identical generated history, policy state or residency.
manifest.sampling_method: Python random.Random(master_seed) used once; complete schedule and all seeds stored here. Runtime never regenerates schedule.
